steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.5 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts; absent artifact after restore causes exit 1) and add enforcing test names inline
Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs)
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); identical body to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh _hydrate_put_back call site to _artifact_persist_put_back (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)
Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: redirect the direct _hydrate_put_back call at line 216 to _artifact_persist_put_back
Write tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh for SPEC-1 and SPEC-2 (run red before implementation)

Add _runner_resume_rehydrate to core/pipeline/runner.sh: calls _artifact_persist_restore then _artifact_persist_put_back; call it at resume entry after line 2768 for all three resume paths; change stale-artifact branch (line 3740-3745) from warn+continue to exit 1
Run tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh and confirm SPEC-1 and SPEC-2 green
Write tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh for SPEC-3 and SPEC-4 (run red before implementation)

Add _runner_from_stage_preflight to core/pipeline/runner.sh: restore+put_back, then verify each pre-target stage has its primary artifact, exit 1 naming missing stage if not; call before dispatch loop when from_stage is set
Run tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh and confirm SPEC-3 and SPEC-4 green
Write tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh for SPEC-7 (run red before implementation)
Fix _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: read cycle_iterations[CYCLE_ID].current_iter via get_state_field (default 1), use it as loop start index

Write tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh for SPEC-9: three sub-cases (--resume flag, auto-resume, zbuild pipeline resume --run-id) each assert state-branch artifact appears in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before first non-complete stage dispatches

Update tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: pre-write intake's primary artifact to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run so SPEC-2 fail-closed path does not break the existing exit-0 assertion
Update tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: if the Phase 1 intake stub does not write intake-result.json, replace with a stub that does; confirm P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
